npcs.name: Fergus the starter
npcs.examine: The starter of the Saltmere Links. He keeps the tee sheet and the scores.

npcs.name: Isla the club pro
npcs.examine: The club pro. She sells the club sets and knows every hole by heart.

npcs.name: Clubhouse chest
npcs.examine: The clubhouse chest, brass-cornered. Everything you own from Ashvale is kept in your arcade wallet; this is where you see it.
